NAME: LUCY
DESCRIPTION: Lucy is a seasoned tracking hound with a scarred left eye and an uncanny ability to detect spectral slimes. Her gray fur bears faint iridescent stains from years of navigating mines, and she carries a broken collar engraved with 'Lucy' as a relic of her training. Though blind in one eye, her snout is perpetually twitching, picking up scents others miss. She barks at shadows, chews on slime-mucus toys, and refuses to abandon Riccardo Grima, her handler, even when confronted by spectral slimes.

ACTIONS.s_text: <PASSIVE> Detects spectral slimes within 20sq. Gains advantage on checks related to Slimes.
ACTIONS.s_flavor: Lucy's nose twitches violently when near residual slime energy, her tail wagging with excitement.

ACTIONS.s_text: <1 BONUS ACTION> Emits a gurgling sound to lure spectral slimes. Targets must succeed on a WIS SAVE or be drawn toward Lucy.
ACTIONS.s_flavor: The air vibrates with an eerie hum as Lucy imitates the whispers of slimes, tricking them into approaching.

ACTIONS.s_text: <1 ACTION> <ATTACK +4> Lucy bites her target with her maws inflicting 1d8+2 piercing damage
